text:
alex: Heads-up — planning to deploy release/response-cache to prod tonight 11:30pm PST. Canary plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% at 15m intervals. Cohorts: 1% internal, 5% beta orgs, 20% NA-west. Need: deploy owner, smoke owner, rollback owner. Anyone available?

sam: I'll take deploy owner. Will kick off and stay until 12:30am PST. :rocket:

julia: I'll own smoke validation. Quick smoke list: small-gen probe (1k tokens), 5 representative prompts, embedding sanity, and latency sweep. Target p50 <200ms, p95 <700ms, errors <0.1% in each window. I'll post results to the thread.

marco: I'll be rollback owner. I'll prepare rollback playbook and monitor logs. If p99 > 1s or error rate >1% for two consecutive 5m windows, trigger rollback.

sam: Backfill: rollout command we'll use:
```
redwoodctl rollout apply --service response-cache --percent 1 --cohort internal --meta "canary-1719999999"
```
I'll bump to 5 then 20 if all green. Can we confirm feature-flag key and deploy window?

alex: Feature flag is `ff/response_cache_v2` — will enable for cohorts during rollout. Deploy window confirmed 11:30pm PST–12:30am PST. I'll ping infra 15m before to warm nodes. :thumbsup:

julia: I'll run these smoke scripts (cc @sam) and post a short table of checks. If any of the critical checks fail (generation quality drop, tokenization errors, or latency spikes), I'll call stop and tag @marco.

marco: Rollback CLI ready:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --service response-cache --to-tag canary-safe --reason "canary-failure-1719999999"
```
Also have an automated job to drain traffic from canary cohorts.

sam: One more: please make sure the observability alerts are armed (latency p99, errors, model OOM). On-call, can you confirm?

oncall-bot: Scheduled: infra-warmup job at 2024-07-15T23:15:00-07:00. Alerts on for team: latency-p99, errors-rate, gpu-oom (channels: #eng-sre, #eng-releases).

alex: Great — final checklist: sam deploy owner, julia smoke owner, marco rollback owner. I'll message 15m before and after each stage. Any objections?

julia: No objections. :eyes:

sam: good to go from my side. I'll post roll start timestamp here.

marco: Standing by. If I don't hear from you by 11:40pm PST, I'll reach out.

alex: Thanks everyone — appreciate quick sync. We'll keep this thread for roll notes.
